hindi: हे इन्द्र और अग्नि, प्रेरक, रथ से चलने वाले, वृत्र के संहारक, अपराजित, उसकी ओर ध्यान दो।
english: O Indra and Agni, impellers, travelling by chariot, slayers of Vṛtra, unconquered, take heed of that.
notes: tośāsā is taken as "impellers" (the exact sense of tośa- is uncertain). The nominatives in the first line stand in apposition to the dual vocative indrāgnī. Vṛtra is kept as a name.

hindi: इस आनन्ददायक मधु को मनुष्यों ने पत्थरों से तुम दोनों के लिए दुहा; हे इन्द्र और अग्नि, उसकी ओर ध्यान दो।
english: Men milked this gladdening sweet drink with stones for you two; O Indra and Agni, take heed of that.
notes: adhukṣann adribhiḥ: the final n of adhukṣan is doubled before the vowel (adhukṣann adribhiḥ). vām is taken as "for you two" (dative sense, an enclitic that may also be genitive).

words.gloss: for the one accompanied by the Maruts

hindi: हे बूँद, मरुतों वाले इन्द्र के लिए बहो, सबसे मधुर; मंत्र-गीत के स्थान में बैठने के लिए।
english: Flow clear, O drop, for Indra, the one accompanied by the Maruts, sweetest, to sit in the seat of the chant.
notes: arka may also be "radiance" or "sun"; "chant" follows the glossary. yoni is rendered "seat" (literally womb, source). āsadam is a Vedic infinitive.

hindi: उन तुम्हें, धारण करने वाले को, वाणी को जानने वाले प्रेरित मेधावी सजाते हैं; लोग तुम्हें भली-भाँति शुद्ध करते हैं।
english: You, that sustainer, the inspired ones, knowers of speech, adorn; the people cleanse you thoroughly.
notes: dharṇasi is taken as "sustainer, support" (sense not fully certain). āyavaḥ is taken as "people" (a plural of āyu); it may also be a tribal name. sam ... mṛjanti is a tmesis (sam before the verb of the second line is separated from it by tvā).
lines_deva: तं त्वा विप्रा वचोविदः परिष्कृण्वन्ति धर्णसिम्
lines_iast: taṃ tvā viprā vacovidaḥ pariṣkṛṇvanti dharṇasim

hindi: हे कवि, तुम्हारे, शुद्ध होते हुए के, रस को मित्र, अर्यमा, वरुण, मरुत पिएँ।
english: O seer, let Mitra, Aryaman, Varuṇa, the Maruts drink the juice of you, the clarifying one.
notes: marutaḥ stands at the end of the second line as a further subject of pibantu. pavamānasya agrees with te (of you).
lines_deva: रसं ते मित्रो अर्यमा पिबन्तु वरुणः कवे
lines_iast: rasaṃ te mitro aryamā pibantu varuṇaḥ kave

words.gram: m. nom. sg. pres. part. pass. √mṛj

hindi: शुद्ध किए जाते हुए, हे कुशल हाथों वाले, तुम समुद्र में वाणी को प्रेरित करते हो; हे शुद्ध होते हुए, तुम लाल-भूरा, प्रचुर, बहुत चाहा गया धन बहाते हो।
english: Being cleansed, O skilful-handed one, you send forth voice in the sea; O clarifying one, you flow forth tawny, abundant, much desired wealth.
notes: puruspṛham is puruḥ-spṛham with the visarga kept before s.

words.gram: m. nom. sg. pres. part. mid. √pū
m. loc. sg. (vāra, vowel printed short)
m. nom. sg. pres. part. mid. √añj

hindi: छन्नी में शुद्ध होता हुआ, भेड़ के बाल में निर्मल होता हुआ, वन में बलवान ने गर्जना की। हे सोम, हे शुद्ध होते हुए, दूध से लेपित होते हुए तुम देवगण के नियत स्थान की ओर बहते हो।
english: Being purified in the strainer, clarifying in the sheep's fleece, the mighty one roared in the wood. O Soma, O clarifying one, being anointed with milk you flow to the appointed place of the gods.

text_flags.why: vowel printed short; read as vāre (vāra, strainer); the alternative is vara 'choice'

notes: vare is read as vāre (vāra, strainer) with the vowel printed short; the alternative is vara "choice". niṣkṛta is taken as "appointed place" (literally prepared, set right); its sense here is uncertain. gobhiḥ is literally "with cows", rendered "with milk" as the object of anointing. vane is "in the wood" (literally; a wooden vessel is not stated).
lines_deva: पुनानो वरे पवमनो अव्यये वृषो अचिक्रदद्वने
देवानाँ सोम पवमान निष्कृतं गोभिरञ्जानो अर्षसि
lines_iast: punāno vare pavamano avyaye vṛṣo acikradadvane
devānā~ soma pavamāna niṣkṛtaṃ gobhirañjāno arṣasi

hindi: इसे, उसे, जिसकी माता नदी है, दस उँगलियाँ शुद्ध करती हैं; वह आदित्यों के साथ दिखाई दिया।
english: This one, that one, whose mother is the river, the ten fingers cleanse; he was seen together with the Ādityas.
notes: The particle u is left untranslated in both languages. akhyata may also be "was proclaimed". Ādityas is kept as the plural class name.
lines_deva: एतमु त्यं दश क्षिपो मृजन्ति सिन्धुमातरम्
lines_iast: etamu tyaṃ daśa kṣipo mṛjanti sindhumātaram

words.gram: n. loc. sg. (e becomes a before ā)

hindi: इन्द्र के साथ और वायु के साथ निचोड़ा हुआ छन्ने में आता है, सूर्य की किरणों के साथ।
english: Pressed, he goes together with Indra and with Vāyu into the filter, together with the rays of the sun.
notes: pavitra ā is pavitre ā. The subject of eti is not named (the pressed one). The second line has no verb of its own and continues eti.
lines_deva: समिन्द्रेणोत वायुना सुत एति पवित्र आ
lines_iast: samindreṇota vāyunā suta eti pavitra ā

hindi: वह, मधुर, हमारे लिए, भग के लिए, वायु के लिए, पूषन् के लिए बहो; मित्र और वरुण में सुन्दर।
english: That one, sweet, flow clear for us, for Bhaga, for Vāyu, for Pūṣan; pleasing to Mitra and to Varuṇa.
notes: mitre varuṇe are locatives, rendered "to" (literally "in"). Bhaga is taken as the god's name since it stands in a list of deities.
lines_deva: स नो भगाय वायवे पूष्णे पवस्व मधुमान्
lines_iast: sa no bhagāya vāyave pūṣṇe pavasva madhumān

words.gram: m. loc. sg. (e becomes a before i)

hindi: धनवती, सुदृढ़ वाज वाली वे हमारे लिए इन्द्र के साथ सहभोज में हों, जिनसे अन्न से समृद्ध हम आनन्द मनाएँ।
english: May the wealthy ones, of mighty prize, be for us at the common feast with Indra, by which, rich in food, we may rejoice.
notes: The feminine revatīḥ has no noun in the text; none is supplied. sadhamāda is sadhamāde before indre (Vedic e becomes a). The prose order of the second line takes kṣumantaḥ with "we".

words.gram: m. nom. sg. pf. part. mid. √i

hindi: सचमुच, तुम जैसा, स्वयं जुता हुआ, स्तोताओं के लिए जाता हुआ, हे साहसी, तुम पहुँचते हो, दोनों पहियों की धुरी की तरह।
english: Indeed, one like you, yoked by oneself, going for the singers, O bold one, you come like an axle of the two wheels.
notes: tvāvāṃ is tvāvān (nasal printed before t). dhṛṣṇavīyānaḥ is resolved as dhṛṣṇo + īyānaḥ (o becomes av before a vowel); the alternative dhṛṣṇu īyānaḥ "going boldly" is possible. ā is taken with ṛṇoḥ (tmesis): "you come". The construction of the last pāda (the na-simile and the case of akṣam) is uncertain.
lines_deva: आ घ त्वावां त्मना युक्तः स्तोतृभ्यो धृष्णवीयानः
lines_iast: ā gha tvāvāṃ tmanā yuktaḥ stotṛbhyo dhṛṣṇavīyānaḥ

hindi: जब, हे सौ शक्तियों वाले, तुम स्तोताओं के सम्मान को, इच्छा को प्राप्त करते हो, धुरी की तरह, शक्तियों के साथ।
english: When, O hundred-powered one, you reach the homage, the desire of the praisers, like an axle, with powers.
notes: ā ... ṛṇoḥ is a tmesis (ā-ṛṇoḥ "reach, come to"); ā occurs twice in the line. The na-simile and the case relation of akṣam are uncertain. jaritṝṇām is the regular genitive plural of jaritṛ.

hindi: सुन्दर रूप बनाने वाले को हम सहायता के लिए प्रतिदिन बुलाते हैं, जैसे गाय दुहने वाले के लिए अच्छी दुधारू गाय को।
english: We call day by day, for aid, the maker of fair forms, like a good milch cow for the cow-milker.
notes: The one called is not named in the text. surūpakṛtnu is taken as "maker of fair forms"; the exact sense of rūpa here (forms or beauty) is open. No verb is supplied in the comparison.

hindi: हमारे सवनों के पास आओ; हे सोमपायी, सोम का पान करो। धनी का आनन्द निश्चय ही गौओं का दाता है।
english: Come near to our pressings; O Soma-drinker, drink of Soma. The exhilaration of the wealthy one is indeed the giver of cows.
notes: godā id: godāḥ loses its visarga before the vowel of id (regular). revataḥ is a genitive singular; the wealthy one is not named.
lines_deva: उप नः सवना गहि सोमस्य सोमपाः पिब
lines_iast: upa naḥ savanā gahi somasya somapāḥ piba

hindi: तब हम तुम्हारे निकटतम सुविचारों को जानें; हमें लाँघकर मत देखो, आओ।
english: Then may we know of your nearest good thoughts; do not look past us, come.
notes: khya is khyaḥ before ā (regular loss of visarga). ati ... khyaḥ is taken as "look past, overlook". vidyāma may also be from √vid "find, obtain". antamānām has no noun; it is taken with sumatīnām.
lines_deva: मा नो अति ख्य आ गहि
lines_iast: mā no ati khya ā gahi

hindi: हे इन्द्र, जब तुमने उषा की तरह दोनों लोकों को भर दिया, तुम्हें, महान् को, महान् जनों के, लोगों के सम्राट् को, देवी माता ने जन्म दिया, कल्याणी माता ने जन्म दिया।
english: When, O Indra, you filled both worlds like Dawn, you the great one, the supreme ruler of the great ones, of the peoples, the goddess mother bore you, the auspicious mother bore you.
notes: Three printed lines (a, b, c) are kept as one unit as in the edition. The syntax runs across the lines: "when you filled ... you, great ... the mother bore (you)"; the object "you" is taken from tvā. Reused from the reviewed rendering of the same verse (p01 ch08, 379), rechecked against the Sanskrit. mahīnām is taken as "of the great ones" (no noun in the text).

hindi: निश्चय ही, लम्बे अंकुश की तरह, हे बुद्धिमान, तुम शक्ति धारण करते हो। हे मघवन्, पहले पद से। देवी माता ने जन्म दिया, कल्याणी माता ने जन्म दिया।
english: Indeed, like a long hook, you bear power, O wise one. With the first foot, O bountiful one, [unclear]. The goddess mother bore, the auspicious mother bore.
notes: The third line is the refrain of the triple (see 1090); its object is not stated, so none is supplied. mantumaḥ is taken as a vocative of a stem in -mat (the form with final -aḥ is unusual); the sense "wise one" is approximate. The words vayām ajo yathā yamaḥ are not made out: vayā "branch", aja "goat", yamaḥ "you restrain" (or the name Yama) cannot be joined into a safe sentence, so the English has [unclear] and the Hindi omits it.
lines_deva: दीर्घँ ह्यङ्कुशं यथा शक्तिं बिभर्षि मन्तुमः
lines_iast: dīrgha~ hyaṅkuśaṃ yathā śaktiṃ bibharṣi mantumaḥ

hindi: बुरा चाहने वाले मनुष्य की दृढ़ता को ढीला करो। उसे पैरों के नीचे कर दो, जो हम पर आक्रमण करता है। देवी माता ने जन्म दिया, कल्याणी माता ने जन्म दिया।
english: Slacken the firmness of the ill-intending mortal. Put under foot him who assails us. The goddess mother bore, the auspicious mother bore.
notes: The particle sma is left untranslated in both languages. sthiram is a neuter adjective used as a noun ("the firm"); an elided noun may be understood but none is supplied. The third line is the refrain of the triple (see 1090). marttasya is printed with doubled t (regular chant spelling). The particle īm is left untranslated in both languages.
lines_deva: अव स्म दुर्हृणायतो मर्त्तस्य तनुहि स्थिरम्
अधस्पदं तमीं कृधि यो अस्माँ अभिदासति
lines_iast: ava sma durhṛṇāyato marttasya tanuhi sthiram
adhaspadaṃ tamīṃ kṛdhi yo asmā~ abhidāsati

hindi: गरजता हुआ, पर्वत पर रहने वाला सोम छन्ने में चारों ओर बह निकला; आनन्दों में तुम सब कुछ देने वाले हो।
english: The resounding Soma, dwelling on the mountain, flowed around in the filter; in the exhilarations you are all-bestowing.
notes: Reused from the reviewed rendering of the same verse (p01 ch10, 475), rechecked; Hindi छन्ना for pavitra follows the glossary. sarvadhā asi: sarvadhāḥ "all-bestowing" is taken as a noun; "in every way" (sarvadhā adv.) is an alternative reading. The second line is a refrain (1093 to 1095).
lines_deva: परि स्वानो गिरिष्ठाः पवित्रे सोमो अक्षरत्
lines_iast: pari svāno giriṣṭhāḥ pavitre somo akṣarat

hindi: तुम प्रेरित मेधावी, तुम कवि, रस से उत्पन्न मधु; आनन्दों में तुम सब कुछ देने वाले हो।
english: You, the inspired one; you, the seer; the sweet drink born forth from the juice; in the exhilarations you are all-bestowing.
notes: The first line has no verb; asi of the refrain is not carried back into it. madhu pra jātam andhasaḥ is taken as "the sweet drink born forth from the juice" (andhasaḥ may be genitive, "of the juice"). Refrain as in 1093.

hindi: तुममें सब देवगण, एकमत होकर, पान को प्राप्त हुए; आनन्दों में तुम सब कुछ देने वाले हो।
english: In you all the gods, of one accord, obtained the drink; in the exhilarations you are all-bestowing.
notes: Refrain as in 1093.

words.gram: m. gen. pl. (Vedic form of rayi)

hindi: वह निचोड़ा जाता है जो धनों का है, जो ऐश्वर्यों का लाने वाला है, जो पोषणों का है; वह सोम जो उत्तम बसे हुए लोगों का है।
english: He is pressed who is of the goods, who is the bringer of riches, who is of the refreshments; the Soma who is of the well-settled peoples.
notes: Reused from the reviewed rendering of the same verse (p01 ch12, 582), rechecked. The genitives depend on an unexpressed word. rāyām is the Vedic genitive plural of rayi. sukṣiti is taken as "well-settled peoples" (kṣiti: dwelling, settlement, hence people; sense approximate).
lines_deva: स सुन्वे यो वसूनां यो रायामानेता य इडानाम्
lines_iast: sa sunve yo vasūnāṃ yo rāyāmānetā ya iḍānām

words.gram: pron. 2 sg. gen. enclitic (e becomes a before i)
1 pl. subj. mid. √kṛ (e becomes a before ā)

hindi: तुम्हारे, जिसका इन्द्र पान करे, जिसका मरुत, अथवा जिसका भग अर्यमा के साथ; जिससे हम मित्र और वरुण को यहाँ लाते हैं, इन्द्र को यहाँ, सहायता के लिए, महान् सहायता के लिए।
english: Of you, of whom Indra may drink, of whom the Maruts, or of whom Bhaga with Aryaman; by whom we bring Mitra and Varuṇa hither, hither Indra, for help, for great help.
notes: ta is te before the vowel of indraḥ; te is taken as "you" in the relative construction (alternatively an enclitic "your" or "for you"). vāryamaṇā is vā + aryamaṇā; aryamaṇā is taken as an instrumental of aryaman (the usual form is aryamṇā). avase mahe: mahe agrees with avase ("great help"). The relative yasya/yena has no antecedent beyond te and the preceding verse is not used. te is rendered "of you" (genitive), as glossed.
lines_deva: यस्य त इन्द्रः पिबाद्यस्य मरुतो यस्य वार्यमणा भगः
आ येन मित्रावरुणा करामह एन्द्रमवसे महे
lines_iast: yasya ta indraḥ pibādyasya maruto yasya vāryamaṇā bhagaḥ
ā yena mitrāvaruṇā karāmaha endramavase mahe

words.gram: m. acc. sg. pres. part. mid. √pū

hindi: हे मित्रो, तुम्हारे आनन्द के लिए शुद्ध होते हुए उसका गान करो। शिशु की तरह उसे हवियों से, स्तुतियों से मधुर बनाते हैं।
english: O friends, sing to him, as he is being purified, for your exhilaration. They sweeten him, like a child, with offerings, with praises.
notes: Reused from the reviewed rendering of the same verse (p01 ch12, 569), rechecked; the added "and" between the two instrumentals is removed. na after śiśum is a plain simile marker ("like a child"). svadayanta may carry imperative force ("let them sweeten"); kept as a plain 3 pl.
lines_deva: तं वः सखायो मदाय पुनानमभि गायत
lines_iast: taṃ vaḥ sakhāyo madāya punānamabhi gāyata

words.gram: m. nom. sg. pres. part. mid. √hi

hindi: बछड़े की तरह माताओं के साथ, प्रेरित की जाती हुई बूँद एक साथ लेपित होती है; देवगण पर अनुग्रह करने वाला आनन्द प्रार्थनाओं से सजाया गया है।
english: Together, like a calf with mothers, the drop, being urged on, is anointed; the exhilaration, favouring the gods, is adorned with prayers.
notes: devāvīḥ is taken as "favouring the gods". mati is rendered "prayer" in this line. The subject of the second line (madaḥ) is taken as a further name of the drop.

hindi: यह कौशल के लिए साधक है, यह समूह के लिए, उपभोग के लिए; यह निचोड़ा हुआ देवगण के लिए अधिक मधुर है।
english: This one is the accomplisher for skill; this one is for the host, for enjoyment; this one, pressed, is sweeter for the gods.
notes: The copula is supplied in both languages. śardha is taken as "host, troop" (it may also mean "might"). sādhana is "accomplishing, effecting".

words.gram: m. nom. pl. pres. part. mid. √su

words.gloss: finders of the light of heaven

hindi: सोम, बूँदें, हमारे लिए निर्मल होकर बहते हैं, मार्ग खोज निकालने में सर्वश्रेष्ठ; मित्र-भाव वाले, निचोड़े जाते हुए, निष्कलंक, उत्तम बुद्धि वाले, सूर्य का प्रकाश पाने वाले।
english: The Somas, the drops, flow clear for us, the best finders of the way: friendly, being pressed, spotless, of good thought, finders of the light of heaven.
notes: The first line recurs in an earlier part (p01 ch12, 548) but the second line there reads svānā; here suvānā is printed, so the line is drafted afresh. svādhyaḥ "of good thought" is not fully certain.

hindi: वे शुद्ध किए गए, बुद्धिमान, दही मिले सोम, सूर्यों की तरह दर्शनीय, गतिशील, घी में स्थिर।
english: Those purified, wise Somas, mixed with curds, like suns worth seeing, moving swiftly, firm in the ghee.
notes: sūrāso na darśatāsaḥ: na is the simile marker "like"; sūra is taken as "sun" (not śūra "hero"). ghṛta may also mean "brightness"; "ghee" is the literal sense. The sentence has no finite verb. dhruvā is dhruvāḥ before gh (regular).
lines_deva: सूरासो न दर्शतासो जिगत्नवो ध्रुवा घृते
lines_iast: sūrāso na darśatāso jigatnavo dhruvā ghṛte

words.gram: m. nom. pl. pf. part. mid. √su
m. nom. pl. pres. part. mid. (root uncertain)

hindi: पत्थरों से निचोड़े जाते हुए गौ की खाल पर, उन्होंने हमारे लिए चारों ओर एक साथ पोषण को स्वर दिया, धन पाने वाले।
english: Being pressed by the stones [unclear] on the hide of the cow, they sounded refreshment together for us on all sides, finders of goods.
notes: citānāḥ (with vi) is not made out and is left [unclear]; the Hindi omits it. goḥ adhi tvaci "on the hide of the cow" is clear. iṣam with asvaran "sounded refreshment" is literal and the construction is uncertain.

words.gram: pron. f. inst. sg. (taken with vasūni)

hindi: इस शुद्धि से इन धनों के साथ बहो; हे बूँद, सरोवर में, माँश्चत्व में आगे दौड़ो। जिसकी गति वायु जैसी है, ब्रघ्न ने भी, पुरुमेध ने भी द्रुतगामी के लिए मनुष्य को स्थापित किया।
english: By this purification flow with these goods; O drop, run forth in the pool, in Māṃścatva. Whose speed is like the wind, even Braghna, even Purumedha placed a man for the swift one.
notes: Very obscure. The first line follows the reviewed rendering of the parallel verse p01 ch11, 541 (there printed indro; here indo is printed, so no flag). māṃścatve is an unexplained word kept as a locative; pavā may be an instrumental of pavā or a corruption; enā is taken with vasūni. In the second line the relative yasya has no clear antecedent, and braghna and purumedhā (names or epithets) and takave are uncertain; the English joins them literally.
lines_deva: अया पवा पवस्वैना वसूनि माँश्चत्व इन्दो सरसि प्र धन्व
ब्रघ्नश्चिद्यस्य वातो न जूतिं पुरुमेधाश्चित्तकवे नरं धात्
lines_iast: ayā pavā pavasvainā vasūni mā~ścatva indo sarasi pra dhanva
braghnaścidyasya vāto na jūtiṃ purumedhāścittakave naraṃ dhāt

words.gram: pron. 1 pl. dat. enclitic (visarga lost before e)

words.gloss: of the one worthy of fame

hindi: और हमारे लिए इस शुद्धि से बहो, कीर्ति के योग्य के प्रसिद्ध घाट पर; साठ हजार धन, पके वृक्ष की तरह नैगुत हिलाता है, आनन्द के लिए।
english: And for us flow clear by this purification, at the famed ford of the one worthy of fame; sixty thousand goods, like a ripe tree the Naiguta shakes, for delight.
notes: The line structure is clear but the words naigutaḥ (a name or epithet), śravāyya, raṇa ("delight" or "battle") and the object of dhūnavat are uncertain; the English follows the word order literally. See also 1106 (nigutaḥ).
lines_deva: उत न एना पवया पवस्वाधि श्रुते श्रवाय्यस्य तीर्थे
षष्टिँ सहस्रा नैगुतो वसूनि वृक्षं न पक्वं धूनवद्रणाय
lines_iast: uta na enā pavayā pavasvādhi śrute śravāyyasya tīrthe
ṣaṣṭi~ sahasrā naiguto vasūni vṛkṣaṃ na pakvaṃ dhūnavadraṇāya

hindi: ये दोनों महान्; इसका बलवान नाम; बल में, माँश्चत्व में अथवा पृशन में, अथवा शस्त्र में। निगुत ने सुला दिया और शत्रुओं को दूर, चेतनाहीन।
english: These two great ones; the mighty name of this one; in strength, in Māṃścatva or in Pṛśana, or in the weapon. Niguta put to sleep, [unclear] and the enemies away, [unclear], the senseless.
notes: Very obscure. mahīme is read as mahī + ime; vṛṣa is a short form whose function is uncertain; māṃścatve and pṛśane are unexplained words kept as locatives. In the second line the sense of snehayat (caus. of √snih) and of apācitaḥ is not made out; the grammatical case of acetaḥ is nominative but its referent is uncertain. Hindi omits the unclear words. nigutaḥ is probably related to naigutaḥ in 1105.
lines_deva: महीमे अस्य वृष नाम शूषे माँश्चत्वे वा पृशने वा वधत्रे
lines_iast: mahīme asya vṛṣa nāma śūṣe mā~ścatve vā pṛśane vā vadhatre

words.gram: m. nom. sg. superl. (visarga lost before u)

hindi: हे अग्नि, तुम हमारे सबसे निकट और रक्षक हो; कल्याणकारी बनो, आश्रय देने वाले बनो।
english: O Agni, you who are nearest to us and a protector: be kind, be sheltering.
notes: Reused from the reviewed rendering of the same line (p01 ch10, 448), rechecked. bhuvaḥ is an injunctive with imperative sense. The unit is a single printed line (a half-verse).
lines_deva: अग्ने त्वं नो अन्तम उत त्राता शिवो भुवो वरूथ्यः
lines_iast: agne tvaṃ no antama uta trātā śivo bhuvo varūthyaḥ

hindi: शुभ अग्नि, धनों के लिए प्रसिद्ध, समीप आओ; सबसे दीप्तिमान, धन दो।
english: Good Agni, famed for goods, approach; most radiant, give wealth.
notes: The nominatives vasuḥ agniḥ are used as address. nakṣi may also be read as 3 sg. ("he reaches"). dāḥ is an injunctive with imperative sense.
lines_deva: वसुरग्निर्वसुश्रवा अच्छा नक्षि द्युमत्तमो रयिं दाः
lines_iast: vasuragnirvasuśravā acchā nakṣi dyumattamo rayiṃ dāḥ

hindi: उन तुम्हें, हे सबसे ज्वलंत, हे दीप्तिमान, हम अब अनुग्रह के लिए, मित्रों के लिए, याचना करते हैं।
english: You, that one, O most blazing, O shining one, we now beg for favour, for friends.
notes: The one addressed is not named in this line. The root of īmahe is uncertain (√yā "beg" is assumed).
lines_deva: तं त्वा शोचिष्ठ दीदिवः सुम्नाय नूनमीमहे सखिभ्यः
lines_iast: taṃ tvā śociṣṭha dīdivaḥ sumnāya nūnamīmahe sakhibhyaḥ

hindi: हम अब इन लोकों को भली-भाँति सिद्ध करें, और इन्द्र तथा सब देवगण।
english: May we now well secure these worlds, and Indra and all the gods.
notes: Reused from the reviewed rendering of the same line (p01 ch10, 452), rechecked. sīṣadhema is taken as a desiderative optative of √sādh "accomplish, secure". The final nominatives (Indra and all the gods) are left open: they may be subjects of the wish with "we", or continue into 1111. GROUPING: 1110 and 1111 read as one sentence (imā ... devāḥ / yajñaṃ ... sīṣadhātu), so they are probably two lines of one verse.
lines_deva: इमा नु कं भुवना सीषधेमेन्द्रश्च विश्वे च देवाः
lines_iast: imā nu kaṃ bhuvanā sīṣadhemendraśca viśve ca devāḥ

hindi: इन्द्र आदित्यों के साथ यज्ञ, हमारा शरीर और संतान सिद्ध करे।
english: Let Indra, together with the Ādityas, secure the sacrifice and our body and offspring.
notes: naḥ is taken with tanvam ("our body"); it could also be read as dative "for us". GROUPING: continues 1110 (see there).
lines_deva: यज्ञं च नस्तन्वं च प्रजां चादित्यैरिन्द्रः सह सीषधातु
lines_iast: yajñaṃ ca nastanvaṃ ca prajāṃ cādityairindraḥ saha sīṣadhātu

hindi: आदित्यों के साथ, गण सहित इन्द्र, मरुतों के साथ हमारे लिए औषधियाँ बनाए।
english: May Indra, with the Ādityas, with the troop, with the Maruts, make remedies for us.
notes: karat is an injunctive with optative sense. sagaṇaḥ is rendered "with the troop"; the troop is not named. The unit is a single printed line.

words.gloss: for the best slayer of Vṛtra

hindi: तुम्हारे इन्द्र के लिए, वृत्र के सबसे श्रेष्ठ संहारक, प्रेरित मेधावी के लिए वह गीत गाओ, जिसे वह पसन्द करता है।
english: Sing forth for your Indra, the best slayer of Vṛtra, the inspired one, the song which he enjoys.
notes: Reused from the reviewed rendering of the same line (p01 ch10, 446), rechecked; vaḥ, which the earlier rendering left out, is now translated as "your" (it may instead be an ethic dative, "for you"). jujoṣate is read as 3 sg. subjunctive "he enjoys". The unit is a single printed line.
lines_deva: प्र व इन्द्राय वृत्रहन्तमाय विप्राय गाथं गायत यं जुजोषते
lines_iast: pra va indrāya vṛtrahantamāya viprāya gāthaṃ gāyata yaṃ jujoṣate

hindi: मरुत, सुन्दर मंत्र-गीत वाले, मंत्र-गीत की स्तुति करते हैं; प्रसिद्ध, युवा, वह इन्द्र गान करता है।
english: The Maruts, of good chants, praise the chant; the famed, young one, that Indra, chants forth.
notes: svarkā is svarkāḥ before ā (visarga lost). stobhati is taken as a verb "chants" (cf. stobha); ā is taken with it. The unit is a single printed line.
lines_deva: अर्चन्त्यर्कं मरुतः स्वर्का आ स्तोभति श्रुतो युवा स इन्द्रः
lines_iast: arcantyarkaṃ marutaḥ svarkā ā stobhati śruto yuvā sa indraḥ

words.gram: pron. 2 sg. gen. enclitic (e becomes a before i)

hindi: मधुर पोषण के समीप निवास करते हुए हम पुष्ट हों; हे इन्द्र, तुम्हारा धन हम धारण करते हैं।
english: Dwelling near, in sweet nourishment, may we thrive; we hold wealth that is yours, O Indra.
notes: Reused from the reviewed rendering of the same line (p01 ch10, 444), rechecked. prakṣe is uncertain (loc. of prakṣ "nourishment, food"). dhīmahe may also be "we meditate on" (√dhī) or "we place". The exact sense of te is uncertain (genitive "your" or dative "for you"). The unit is a single printed line.
lines_deva: उप प्रक्षे मधुमति क्षियन्तः पुष्येम रयिं धीमहे त इन्द्र
lines_iast: upa prakṣe madhumati kṣiyantaḥ puṣyema rayiṃ dhīmahe ta indra
